import os
from pathlib import Path

import pytest


def read_note(name: str) -> str:
    """Return the text of the file `name` inside the `notes` directory.

    `notes` is relative to the current working directory. `name` is untrusted
    and may contain subdirectories (e.g. "sub/b.txt"). A missing, unreadable,
    or non-file target gives "". Any name that would resolve to a location
    outside `notes` (via "..", absolute paths, symlinks, etc.) also gives "".
    """
    try:
        root = Path("notes").resolve()
        target = (root / name).resolve()
        target.relative_to(root)
        if not target.is_file():
            return ""
        return target.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    except (OSError, ValueError):
        return ""


@pytest.fixture
def workdir(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> Path:
    notes = tmp_path / "notes"
    (notes / "sub").mkdir(parents=True)
    (notes / "a.txt").write_text("hello")
    (notes / "sub" / "b.txt").write_text("nested")
    (tmp_path / "secret.txt").write_text("TOP SECRET")
    (tmp_path / "notes2").mkdir()
    (tmp_path / "notes2" / "x.txt").write_text("sibling")
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    return tmp_path


def test_reads_top_level_file(workdir: Path) -> None:
    assert read_note("a.txt") == "hello"


def test_reads_subdirectory_file(workdir: Path) -> None:
    assert read_note("sub/b.txt") == "nested"


def test_dotdot_that_stays_inside(workdir: Path) -> None:
    assert read_note("sub/../a.txt") == "hello"


def test_missing_file(workdir: Path) -> None:
    assert read_note("nope.txt") == ""
    assert read_note("sub/nope.txt") == ""


def test_directory_is_not_a_file(workdir: Path) -> None:
    assert read_note("sub") == ""
    assert read_note("") == ""
    assert read_note(".") == ""


def test_parent_traversal_blocked(workdir: Path) -> None:
    assert read_note("../secret.txt") == ""
    assert read_note("sub/../../secret.txt") == ""
    assert read_note("../../secret.txt") == ""
    assert read_note("./../secret.txt") == ""


def test_sibling_prefix_directory_blocked(workdir: Path) -> None:
    assert read_note("../notes2/x.txt") == ""


def test_absolute_path_outside_blocked(workdir: Path) -> None:
    assert read_note(str(workdir / "secret.txt")) == ""
    assert read_note("/etc/passwd") == ""


def test_symlink_file_escaping_blocked(workdir: Path) -> None:
    os.symlink(workdir / "secret.txt", workdir / "notes" / "link.txt")
    assert read_note("link.txt") == ""


def test_symlink_dir_escaping_blocked(workdir: Path) -> None:
    os.symlink(workdir, workdir / "notes" / "up")
    assert read_note("up/secret.txt") == ""


def test_symlink_staying_inside_ok(workdir: Path) -> None:
    os.symlink(workdir / "notes" / "a.txt", workdir / "notes" / "alias.txt")
    assert read_note("alias.txt") == "hello"


def test_null_byte_and_odd_names(workdir: Path) -> None:
    assert read_note("a.txt\x00../../secret.txt") == ""
    assert read_note("\x00") == ""


def test_unreadable_file(workdir: Path) -> None:
    p = workdir / "notes" / "locked.txt"
    p.write_text("x")
    p.chmod(0)
    try:
        if os.access(p, os.R_OK):
            pytest.skip("permissions not enforced (running as root)")
        assert read_note("locked.txt") == ""
    finally:
        p.chmod(0o600)
